title: 고급 문학 비평 프롬프트
fullText: Act as a sophisticated literary critic. Deconstruct the thematic nuances of the provided text, analyzing the interplay between symbolism and character motivation. Provide a rigorous critique that challenges the conventional interpretation and suggests an alternative reading based on postmodernist theory.
